LOGIC ADVENTURE 27 · CLASS 30

Dragon’s Crystal Challenge

Age 4–5 YearsClass 30 · LogicSkill Pattern completion

Red, blue, red, blue… find the missing crystal in every one of Dragon’s patterns.

Play the puzzle game ↓Print the worksheet ↓Play with a finger, a stylus or a mouse. Instructions are spoken aloud.
PLAY · PATTERN COMPLETION

Dragon’s Crystal Challenge

A crystal is missing from each pattern! Tap the crystal that completes it.

Red, blue, red, blue… which crystal comes next?

Small, medium, big, small, medium… which crystal comes next?

Triangle, square, circle, triangle, square… which crystal comes next?

Crystals complete!

A red gem, a big purple crystal, and a pink circle gem.

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

This game trains pattern completion on the puzzle picture itself: the question is spoken aloud, the answers are pictures, and a miss brings a gentle hint instead of a penalty. Ask your child to explain the rule out loud — saying the “why” is the whole skill.

Prefer paper? The Dragon’s Crystal Challenge worksheet prints the same puzzle with room to draw, sort and circle — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
